# Preset UI Studio (v2.0)
> A full browser-based, exportable, dependency-free UI library with 30 components, 4 complete patterns, an interactive playground, a sandboxed code inspector, component JSON imports and private local file workspace.

## Canonical reference files
- [Visual and AI implementation guide](./AI_REFERENCE.md)
- [Human documentation](./docs/)
- [Machine-readable design tokens](./design-tokens.json)
- [Reusable component CSS](./assets/css/kit.css)
- [Exportable demo interactions](./assets/js/kit-interactions.js)
- [Button examples](./assets/data/buttons.js)
- [Form examples](./assets/data/forms.js)
- [Navigation examples](./assets/data/navigation.js)
- [Feedback examples](./assets/data/feedback.js)
- [Surfaces examples](./assets/data/surfaces.js)
- [Page patterns](./assets/data/patterns.js)
- [Project README](./README.md)
- [AI coding agent instructions](./AGENTS.md)

## Usage
Use this as a visual and front-end behavior reference, not as a hosted backend. Read actual CSS and catalog source before reproducing the style. If the AI system cannot access repository files, request their contents. Preserve the user's original application functionality, routing and backend.

## Repository
https://github.com/taithedev/PresetWebsiteUI
